messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync  post-launch signal: three enterprise customers reported flaky completions and one reported a JSON-structured output regression. Early asks: fix the flakiness ASAP; structured-output mismatch can be a follow-on.
Raj (eng): Got it. I looked at logs: most flakes correlate with partial token drops during retry flow on dedicated pods. Not the generation kernel itself.
Noah (SRE): If retries are causing partial responses we might be hitting a race in request cancellation + streaming. We can hotpatch by making the retry path conservative (single retry) while we triage. Low blast radius if we roll forward a pod-side flag.
Ivy (QA): Can we get a minimal repro and a golden-candidate prompt set? I can add regression tests to CI and run them on canary.
Maya (PM): Customers prefer immediate reliability even if it temporarily increases retries. Priority: Reliability > perfect JSON formatting. We'll communicate that to them.
Raj (eng): Plan A (hotpatch): flip retry to single attempt + add server-side idempotency check. Acceptance: no partial responses for 24h on affected customers and no increase in error rate. Plan B (follow-up): structured-output eval and prompt normalization work tracked as enhancement.
Noah (SRE): I'll schedule a canary to prod-minor and add traffic shaping limiting to 10% of affected tenants. Also enable verbose tracing for 2h to gather evidence.
notifier-bot: Rolling canary started for commit 9d8f7e.
Ivy (QA): Adding smoke tests now. Quick script: `POST /v1/chat` with streaming enabled, verify final event `done` and JSON parse success.
Raj (eng): Test note: add a check for stream reassembly on the client side to catch partial chunking; server-side fix should prevent those triggers.
Maya (PM): Timeline: hotpatch this morning, customer note within 2 hours. Enhancement ticket for structured-output to include acceptance: schema compliance > 95% on sample prompts and no regression in latency.
Ivy (QA): Ran smoke suite against canary — partial response rate dropped from 4.2% -> 0.3% for the sampled tenants. No new errors seen.
Noah (SRE): Canary looks healthy. Rolling to global in 45m. Keeping verbose traces on for 1h post-roll.
Raj (eng): I'll open the enhancement RFC for structured-output work: items include canonicalizer, prompt templates, and tests. Propose owners: Raj (eng), Ivy (QA), Maya (PM).
Maya (PM): Sounds good. Please include customer repros and priority mapping (customer A high, others medium). Also include rollout plan (canary to 5% -> 25% -> 100%) and rollback criteria.
notifier-bot: Canary promotion to global started for commit 9d8f7e.
Maya (PM): I'll draft the customer communication now: brief, transparent, mention mitigation and next steps. Will share copy here for review before sending.
Ivy (QA): One ask for the enhancement: add a benchmark against the current cost model. We don't want schema-normalization to increase per-token CPU by more than 10%.
Raj (eng): Noted. For the follow-up, I suspect a lightweight normalizer plus sample-based eval will be enough; heavy-handed NLU fixes can be deferred.
Maya (PM): Decision captured: hotpatch rolled (retry reduced + idempotency), customers notified, structured-output becomes an enhancement with acceptance metrics (schema compliance >95%, CPU delta < 10%), owners assigned, design review next Wed. Closing thread after customer ack. Thanks all :raised_hands:
